verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found an OpenAPI document served at https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing an "openapi" key), so a machine-readable spec can be downloaded directly. The REST reference pages corroborate a documented REST surface that such a spec would describe. missing for 10: first-party documentation that announces or links the spec, evidence that it covers all endpoints (inference, management, gRPC), and independent corroboration of its accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
